In 522 AFA The [[2nd Areoix Lie Empire|2nd Empire of Areoix Lie]] after the end of the [[Arten Uprising]] The city would Remain untouched by the war however the [[Almaglean plague]] had left the city empty and deserted. It is estimated a only a 150,000 of the cities 500,000 survived the plague. [[House Un Lie]] would become extremely powerful in and around the city during this era.The population is only believed to have recovered in the late 630s AFA. The [[Firvan system]] would be reintroduced a year after the [[Arten Uprising]] which would remain unchanged until the [[Declaration of Rights]]. In 587 AFA the town of [[Havan]] was raided and sacked by the [[Rauh tribe]]. The Tribe was [[The Rauh Massacre|mascaraed]] shortly after and its lands repopulated. [[The Mad Emperor Gion]] would [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massacre massacre] all groups he believed to not be pure [[Arten]] all within the walls of [[Vurahi]]. The [[Imperial Aten Border War]] in 648 AFA would lead to a mass [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exodus exodus] of young men and their families into the [[Arten Frontier]]. This would invoke a period of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stagnation stagnation] within the [[Vurahi]] for the city for the next 50 years. ( insert great church construction and completion here ). The [[3rd Arten-Grasis]] war would result in a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exodus exodus] of young men as the [[Imperial Aten Border War]] 100 years later. In 803 AFA the [[Terresin district]] was established and would only continue to grow year after year. Traveler [[Je Moy]] from [[Dahe]] would pass through [[Vurahi]] in 876 AFA. His writings tell us a unbiased report of the city during this era. The most impressive thing from his writings is the state of [[Vurahi Imperial Gardens]].
